argv:
import datetime,fcntl,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
s=json.loads(Path('.local/jobs/halfkp-fixed-model-radix-speed-v1.json').read_text());assert s['status']=='complete' and s['child_pid'] is None
assert not Path('/proc/812760').exists(),'radix speed producer must exit'
assert datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)<datetime.datetime(2026,11,7,4,20,tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),'reserve at least100minutes before runtime cutoff'
compute=subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-compute-apps=pid','--format=csv,noheader,nounits'],text=True).strip();assert not compute,compute
lock=Path('.local/run/engine.lock').open('a');fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
r={'passed':True,'verified_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'radix_speed_producer_absent':True,'gpu_compute_processes':[],'default_engine_lock_available':True,'scope':'full1024 ordinary2000ms sameD42 C30 vs C30+radix only'}
with Path('results/2026-11-07/halfkp-fixed-model-radix-ordinary-preflight-v1.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(r))

from pathlib import Path;import json;p=Path('.local/evaluation/development-halfkp-fixed-w8-h0-128m-radix-v1/comparison.json');x=json.loads(p.read_text());assert sum(x[k] for k in ('both_correct','baseline_only','candidate_only','both_wrong'))==1024;Path('results/2026-11-07/development-halfkp-fixed-w8-h0-128m-radix-v1-comparison.json').open('x').write(p.read_text())
